title: Coastal Park Ocean View, 1941 California B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1941 black-and-white snapshot photograph capturing a serene coastal park overlooking the Pacific Ocean, reminiscent of Palisades Park in Santa Monica, California. Large leafy trees and a tall palm tree frame the right side, providing shade for visitors seated on park benches along the bluff. A rustic wooden fence lines the cliff edge, with a low building and distant coastal mountains visible across the water in the background.
